architectural_finding: Changing soft capacitor sides before generic packing also rearranges owners and unchanged-side output bulk. The later owned-group constructor moves only bypass capacitors, fixing owners and output bulk, so it cannot repair that bulk displacement. Repeated aspect tuning does not address this coupling. Investigate owner-relative group construction that accounts for the full declared group and explicitly preserves bulk relationships; do not silently grant shared bulk a bypass objective or movement permission.
